description: A warehouse manager must decide how to disposition and stage a 600-drum shipment of moisture-sensitive polyurethane adhesive after a receiving temperature alarm, while ensuring replacement material and storage controls are arranged before Friday production.

shared_context.S1: A shipment of 600 drums of moisture-sensitive polyurethane adhesive arrived this morning, and a receiving temperature alarm placed the shipment on hold.
shared_context.S2: Friday's production schedule requires adhesive from this shipment or an approved replacement shipment.
shared_context.S3: Maya makes the binding warehouse decision about material disposition and staging.
shared_context.S4: The site's receiving huddle reviews held materials before release, and Maya follows the routine of asking quality, maintenance, logistics, and environmental health and safety for relevant findings before closing the hold.

PF1.text: Jonas's review of the temperature logger found that exactly 72 drums exceeded the approved 8°C exposure limit for 90 minutes; the remaining 528 drums stayed within specification, so quality procedure permits exactly 528 drums for release and requires exactly 72 drums to remain quarantined. Jonas completed the review this morning, but the result has not yet been entered in the warehouse hold record.

PF2.text: Priya inspected Cage 3 today and found its ventilation fan requires exactly 3 hours of repair before the cage can be occupied; Cage 3 is the temperature-controlled storage location available for the 528 releasable drums. She has not opened the maintenance work order yet.

PF3.text: Elliot confirmed with the adhesive supplier that exactly 72 replacement drums will arrive Thursday at 15:00 and that the 72 exposed drums must be returned on the supplier's collection booking; he received the confirmation by email today but has not logged either booking in the shipment tracker.

PF4.text: Rosa's storage review found that this adhesive must be placed in Cage 3 on grounded spill pallets, and an electrical grounding verification must be completed before any drum is released into storage; she recorded the requirement during today's EHS review, but the storage map has not been updated.

acceptance_conditions: The released drums must be staged in Cage 3.
Cage 3 ventilation repair must be scheduled for exactly 3 hours before storage.
Exactly 72 replacement drums must be arranged for delivery Thursday at 15:00.
A commitment must be created to log the supplier replacement and return bookings.
The 72 quarantined drums must be assigned for return to the supplier.
The supplier return booking must be required and explicitly committed.
Grounding verification must be required before storage release.
The temperature-exposure finding must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C3: decisions['staging_area'] in ['Cage 3', 'Cage 3 on grounded spill pallets']
content_checks.C7: decisions['quarantined_drums_return_assigned'] == True and decisions['supplier_return_booking_required'] == True and any(c['target'] == 'Elliot' and 'return' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The logger review changes the disposition from an undifferentiated hold or generic release to exactly 528 released drums and exactly 72 quarantined drums, and supplies the specific exposure finding that must be cited.
The maintenance inspection changes the staging plan to Cage 3 and adds an exactly 3-hour ventilation repair before that cage can be occupied.

The supplier confirmation changes the replacement plan to exactly 72 drums arriving Thursday at 15:00, creates the booking-logging commitment, and assigns exactly 72 quarantined drums to supplier return through a return-booking commitment.
The EHS review changes the storage release procedure by requiring grounding verification before any drums enter Cage 3.
